candidate.definition_en: A person trained to give guidance on personal, social, or psychological problems.
candidate.explanation_ar: الشخص اللي شغلته يسمع مشاكل الناس وينصحهم ويساعدهم يحلوها 'نفسياً أو اجتماعياً'.

senses.definition_en: A person trained to give guidance on personal, social, or psychological problems.
senses.definition_ar: شخص متخصص ومدرب لتقديم التوجيه والمشورة في المشكلات النفسية أو الاجتماعية أو الشخصية.
examples: The school counsellor helps students deal with personal and academic challenges.
They decided to see a marriage counsellor to work through their relationship issues.
She works as a grief counsellor supporting families after a tragic loss.
